purpose: Keep a vetted list of news sources: find candidates, trial them in research notebooks, and ask Martin to promote good ones.

inputs.what: trial notebooks; new_source_candidates from P1/P4 research runs

steps.do: Gather candidates proposed during the week (only X, arXiv, mainstream media, Reddit)
Score each trial source on 2+ weeks of items (freshness, signal, accuracy, overlap)
One Inbox question: promote / reject listed sources, with evidence
steps.when: any source scored ≥ 4 or a vetted one dropped < 2

done_when: Martin's answer applied or still pending (issue blocked, not closed)

approvals.notes: No outward action. Promotion to vetted needs Martin.
